source_a_game_of_thones_jumpchain.description: Perks from A Game of Thones Jumpchain.

animal_companion.name: Animal Companion
animal_companion.description: In this land, it’s somewhat common for people to have animal companions by their side. Whilst this item won’t get you a dragon, a sapient creature or anything which has absolutely no basis in this setting (such as trying to get a legend of zelda cuccoo as a pet), there are few real limits on size or species of animal. Examples of what can be gained through this item include a direwolf, mammoth, lion, eagle, hawk, viper, horse, war elephant or raven. Animals gained through this item are smart, loyal companions with a near human intelligence. The default is whatever would make sense for your origin, such as a Stark having a direwolf, a giant having a mammoth or a golden company member having a war elephant. If you have any animal based magics such as warging, this animal is far better suited for it and slightly boosts the effectiveness of such abilities.

baby_dragon.name: Baby Dragon
baby_dragon.description: A single baby dragon that you’ve hatched and has bonded to you. This beast while small will grow at an incredible rate and eventually become a Medieval superweapon easily able to lay waste to armies of men. Beyond this jump the dragon will grow with you becoming more powerful as you grow in power so that it may forever stand by your side. Alternatively, it could be an egg that hatches whenever you want it to, and can rehatch each jump.

dragonbinder.name: Dragonbinder
dragonbinder.description: A priceless relic of Old Valyria, this horn has the unique ability to bind dragons and their kin. Whenever blown any draconic creatures within earshot will be forced to kneel to you, completely incapable of going against you and entirely submissive.

unparalleled_rider.name: Unparalleled Rider
unparalleled_rider.description: It’s as if you were born in the saddle, for you are able to ride any kind of steed better than anyone in a few generations. You are also truy capable of caring for your steeds, as well as make them easily follow your commands.

source_a_game_of_thromes_jumpchain.description: Perks from A Game of Thromes Jumpchain.

maester_of_the_citadel.name: Maester of the Citadel
maester_of_the_citadel.description: Whether you are a Maester, or simply have the accreditation, you have studied enough to have forged a full chain, and are the equal of any Maester of the Citadel in academic knowledge. This knowledge stretches from healing to scholarly knowledge, science and the training of ravenry, who carry messages in the Seven Kingdoms.

well_read.name: Well Read
well_read.description: An educated man is a valuable thing in any time. In addition to basic literacy in the local language, and common trade languages, you have a wide yet shallow general knowledge appropriate for a learned person of Planetos.

source_a_game_of_thrones_jumpchain.description: Perks from A Game of Thrones Jumpchain.

cold_hands.name: Cold Hands
cold_hands.description: It is common for men to break when they come eye to eye with the Dark. You are made of far stronger stuff. Even tortured to the brink, isolated and abandoned, you will never forget your beliefs and purpose. If you are part of an organization, that organization will always recognize you as one of them, as long as you abide by their rules to the best of your ability. In addition, your adamantine will grants you immunity to possession or trickery based magics such as warging, mind control, glamours or shadow binding.

sellsword_for_hire.name: Sellsword for Hire
sellsword_for_hire.description: Despite the feudal nature of this world, you have no troubles travelling the land, and can easily be hired by competing factions without them killing you. Want to work for Tyrwin, then go live in the Sunspear? Go ahead. Want to live as a free folk then join the Umber’s household? Sure. Want to be a Night’s Watchmen, then leave? I guess. Essentially, despite anything you might normally expect, you may freely join or leave an organisation without consequence.

travel_supplies.name: Travel Supplies
travel_supplies.description: A leather satchel which, when opened, contains the minimum needed to survive in the wild, as well as enough food for the day. Each day, the contents of the bag will change to cover this, with, for example, an arctic biome providing (among other things) warm clothes, firewood and a tinderbox, whilst a desert locale might provide thin, light, covering clothes, extra water and a tent. Once a week the perishables are replaced.

travelers_hospitalit.name: Traveler’s Hospitalit
travelers_hospitalit.description: A hearth to rest one’s feet at, and a table to eat and drink at, something we all desire and something many travelers don’t always get, is something you can get with ease. You have a bit of an aura that makes people pen their doors to allow you to stay and rest for a bit so long as you aren’t a problem. Of course this can always be undone if you’re a monster who rapes and pillages his/her way across nations but in that case why would you be looking for friendly fellowship?

frey_pies.name: Frey Pies
frey_pies.description: You are a world class chef capable of making any material taste delicious, and masking any flavour. Literally any flavour.

musical_skill.name: Musical Skill
musical_skill.description: The art of Song and Instruments, one you're quite talented at, to the point that many would compare your skill to the late Prince Rhaegar Targaryen. Weaving new songs and music comes as easy to you as winning the hearts and minds of your audience and you’ll find that you seem to never run out of inspiration; drawing ideas from your experiences and environment. To think, with this alone you could indeed make quite a lot of coin; though do be careful, not every King or Lord enjoys a good song.

silver_tongue.name: Silver Tongue
silver_tongue.description: You are a skillful orator, storyteller, and performer, capable of great snark and japes. As a side effect of this, you are a truly brilliant liar and incredibly persuasive as a general rule.

mountain_of_gold.name: Mountain of Gold
mountain_of_gold.description: Much like the Lannisters of Casterly Rock, you now own a truly impressive gold mine. This gold mine could be mined for centuries - millennia perhaps without running dry. In addition, you own a mint which will print valid money for you from now on. Please be aware that this does not come with inflation protections, so you could truly wreck the economy if you spent too much.

smith.name: Smith
smith.description: You are a skilled blacksmith, capable of forging most things seen on Planetos. Items forged by you are better at their intended function in some way, with swords being sharper, plows plowing more easily, armor blocking blows more easily, or decorative items being more eye catching. Whilst by default you cannot forge Valyrian Steel, if you also purchase the Valyrian Steelsmith perk further down, you will no longer need access to dragon fire to create such works and will be capable of working with starmetal.

tradecraft_skills.name: Tradecraft Skills
tradecraft_skills.description: You have skills in a mundane trade of your choice which someone of Planetos of your political standing, geographic location and time could conceivably learn. This includes being a Myrrish glassmaker, a carpenter, a brewer or other such trades.

a_proficient_warrior.name: A Proficient Warrior
a_proficient_warrior.description: You are the equal of any knight in swordfighting, jousting and riding, as well as capable to care for your armor and weapons without the aid of a squire. You have a weapon you are slightly more skilled in, than your average knight, whether that is a greatsword, a warhammer or something different.

sword_of_the_morning.name: Sword of the Morning
sword_of_the_morning.description: You are one of the greatest warriors to grace the face of Planetos in a generation. Your mind and body are in perfect sync with combat. You could easily analyze a battlefield to create an imaginary version of it in your Mind’s Eye to easily predict the movements of your opponent until they stop being a threat... or if they play dead. You could fight 10 men, perhaps even 20 by yourself, and come out without a scratch. Against truly skilled opponents on the level of Ned Stark in his prime, this number goes down to 4-7. This is quite straining to a baseline human, but it is possible to expand the limits of your predictions with training, unnatural modifications or perks from another Jump. You also gain a substantial increase in skill to dual wield your preferred weapon with the same level of mastery that you wield one.

unsullied_grit.name: Unsullied Grit
unsullied_grit.description: You have unbreakable will, easily equal to that of the Unsullied Legions from Astapor, able to stand through extreme pain and hardship. You are also capable to completely control yourself, no longer falling into a bloodthirsty rage in the case of a battle, only to then commit atrocities.

valyrian_steel_armour.name: Valyrian Steel Armour
valyrian_steel_armour.description: By purchasing this armour, you have gained one of the greatest personal protections available in this entire setting. At first pierceable only by another Valyrian Steel weapon, as you grow in power, this armour will scale with you. Be aware, that it only protects the parts it covers, so if you’re shot through your visor, you’re shit out of luck.

pyromancy.name: Pyromancy
pyromancy.description: One of the more widely practiced magical disciplines, Pyromancy is the use of magic to manipulate fire. Known uses are the use of flames as weapons, engulfing weapons, as items of spectacle, and as mediums for other abilities - such as the priests of R’hllor using flames to perform divination. Pyromancers also have skill in other ways of creating and controlling fire, including the use of powders, walking the hot coals and making fiery symbols in the air.

a_coin_in_little_fingers.name: A Coin in Little Fingers
a_coin_in_little_fingers.description: You have a way with money that most don’t gain in their lifetime, for you’re able to turn investments into entire enterprises and find money in industries no one else would and how to manage your economy with ease. For this extends to cover all avenues of trade such as seaborne and others and you’ll always be the first to find out about new and more importantly wealth inducing trends. In the right position, you can sink an entire empire into dangerous levels of debt. You can easily do the opposite as well, and make the kingdom flourish, creating trade opportunities that wouldn't have existed without your expertise.

brothels.name: Brothels
brothels.description: You own a shop chain of some kind which caters to some form of vice. By default, this is a brothel, but whatever it is, the business provides you with a stable source of income in the range of 500 to 700 dragons a year. The main benefit of this item is the blackmail it provides however, as whatever the type, your chain attracts the patronage of the rich and powerful. Thanks to this, you will regularly discover blackmail on various high profile individuals, as well as evidence to corroborate this. Sadly however, you cannot control who you gain blackmail on, so if you’re aiming to extort a particular person, you’re shit out of luck. You can freely import businesses to gain this effect if you wish.

safehouse.name: Safehouse
safehouse.description: Sometimes, a man of wealth has to simply drop off the radar for a little while. Now you can do so in style. This lavishly appointed town house in a foreign city comes with servants and a fiat backed guarantee that as long as you actively are trying to hide, that your enemies will not find you. This can also be used as a handy way to hide people - such as your crush’s daughter who you’re trying to turn into your sex slave - where they will never be found. Sadly, it does not come with anything stopping anyone from escaping.

blood_magic.name: Blood Magic
blood_magic.description: Blood magic, or blood sorcery as it is sometimes called, is commonly considered to be the darkest and possibly most powerful of magics, capable of near anything with enough sacrifice. Examples of it’s abilities include healing, the merging of animals of different species into one, the changing of physical appearance, enchantment, artificing, resurrection and all manner of other abilities. The greater the magic, the more which must be sacrificed. Sacrifices must be personal or valuable, with greater sacrifices granting greater power.

necromancy.name: Necromancy
necromancy.description: The magic of life and death, necromancy is a fell magic used by a number of individuals including Qyburn, the Others, some Qarthian Warlocks, and the Bloodstone Emperor. By purchasing this perk, you have gained the ability to raise groups of undead wights bound by your will and life force, as well as the ability to perform a true resurrection once per year.

the_blood_of_kings.name: The Blood of Kings
the_blood_of_kings.description: For most maegi of Planetos, the main struggle of magic is creating a large enough sacrifice. Thankfully, thanks to this perk, a weaker sacrifice can be used instead, with no loss in power. If the magic calls for mass human sacrifice you may get away with a single human sacrifice and a whole lot of animals. If instead it calls for human life, human flesh should work. If it needs a single animal sacrifice, or human blood, you may scrape through with pure willpower. Nonetheless, for whatever reason, when it comes to you, magic seems just a touch cheaper.

born_of_the_divine.name: Born of the Divine
born_of_the_divine.description: There was a divinity in your family history, and no matter how many generations the benefits have skipped over, they are shining through you now. You’re a little taller, a lot smarter, a little more attractive and charming, and a fair bit stronger and faster than you were before.

dirty_secrets.name: Dirty Secrets
dirty_secrets.description: It’s truly a wonderful thing when people decide to work with you of their own free will, but unfortunately that isn’t always reality and so “motivation” may need to be given. Well you seem to have just that, located within a locked safe in your possession is a decent amount of blackmail for a number of middling Lords/officials in your nation. While it may lack material for the High Lords or Magisters it will provide you with a number of “contacts” who will only be too willing to use their influence to your benefit.

the_onion_knight.name: The Onion Knight
the_onion_knight.description: You are an amazing smuggler. This may not sound like much, but it comes with a host of benefits. You are a master sailor, capable of taming the fiercest of sea storms, and in addition, are truly superb at hiding things. When hiding things, you seem to release a weak form of SEP field, which stops officials and unwanted individuals from noticing your concealed cargo. This SEP field shorts out if A) your hidden items are physically discovered (eg. falling through a hidden door), or B) you rely solely upon it for protection. Finally, if you are ever caught, officials will be far less likely to hit you with the full punishment. You will still be punished, but the punishment itself will be drastically reduced in severity.

valyrian_steel_dagger.name: Valyrian Steel Dagger
valyrian_steel_dagger.description: You are the proud owner of a Valyrian Steel dagger. Or not. See, this dagger is special beyond just being made of one of the strongest metals on the planet and worth an exorbitant amount of money. Anyone who you try to hoodwink or bamboozle whilst wearing this will be far more likely to believe whatever bullshit you’re spinning. Those with tricky minds, or strong will can break through its effect however.

divination.name: Divination
divination.description: Whether you do it by looking into the heart of the flames, communing with the weirwoods, or simply have it as an innate gift, you are capable of seeing other events. At first, this gift will manifest as fleeting glimpses of important events occuring for those close to you, but with practice, you will eventually be able to see first the past, and then later, the future. The limitation on only being able to see the fates of those who you know will go away as you get stronger.

dragonglass_candle.name: Dragonglass Candle
dragonglass_candle.description: A candle made of obsidian, Dragonglass candles are magical artifacts which when burnt, allow the mage using them to see across mountains, seas and deserts, give men visions and dreams and communicate with one another half a world apart. Light behaves bizarrely around them, with whites becoming as white as freshly fallen snow, reds like flame, yellows like gold and shadows so black they look like holes in the world. Ordinarily, to light the candles requires magic to be strong, but given that you’ve paid good CP, you may light them at will.

strands_of_fate_are_meaningless.name: Strands Of Fate Are Meaningless
strands_of_fate_are_meaningless.description: This world shares a very important trait with your world that many others lack, the fact that death can be right around the corner and when your luck has run out and you’ve been surrounded it is the end. For this is the power you hold, anyone who you clash with has any protection from fate/plot armor removed and is thus forced to face you like a normal person with only their abilities. This is also applied to plans and such of yours which would normally fail due to the intervention of obscene luck or fate allowing you to be a threat to even the greatest heros.

a_reyne_of_terror.name: A Reyne of Terror
a_reyne_of_terror.description: You are a very intimidating person. How this presents depends largely on what you are doing. If you're acting honorably, they will see you as someone truly noble. Alternatively, if you're acting with ill intent, they will see you as someone to be scared of. This comes with a willpower boost whenever you are doing something you believe necessary.

advisor_to_the_throne.name: Advisor to the Throne
advisor_to_the_throne.description: It is a sad but common fact amongst those who seek to advise kings, that their leaders do not always take it very well. Whether it be Aerys burning those who bring him bad news or Cersei imprisoning those who speak against her, rulers often give gruesome fates to those who tell them things they don’t want to hear. Luckily, you will never share those unlucky souls’ fate, as, no matter your personal relationship with someone, their mental state or the particular news, you can be safe in the knowledge that they will both take it on board and won’t kill, harm, torture, censure or otherwise inconvenience you for doing so. This only works if you are honest, sincere and faithful in your attempts to help however, so lying to them about important information, inciting rebellion amongst their subjects or undermining their rule would still get you arrested or executed for treason.

breaker_of_chains.name: Breaker of Chains
breaker_of_chains.description: When you make a decree which is unpopular, the people damn well follow through with it, because you are their leader! With this perk, any orders you make are actually followed in both word and spirit.

first_choice.name: First Choice
first_choice.description: When someone is considering`who to appoint for a position you desire, you will be the first name that comes to mind. Whilst this won’t stop them from choosing someone grossly more qualified and experienced, it will give you an edge if it’s a choice between you, and someone of a similiar or slightly greater competence.

great_manse.name: Great Manse
great_manse.description: As a diplomat, you generally represent some powerful faction. As such, you have been provided with a great manse to show off your (and your faction’s) status. This lodging is almost decadently luxurious, coming with fine furnishings and an array of servants to look after it.

guest_rites.name: Guest Rites
guest_rites.description: By taking this perk, those with whom you make promises or agreements in good faith are far more likely to hold to them. This is strongest in promises not to attack you, but even then, sufficiently motivated or honorless individuals may break them. To break agreements made with you would generally require someone to hate you with all their being, be single mindedly devoted to whatever cause motivates them, or in some other way find breaking the oath to be the lesser problem

king_beyond_the_wall.name: King Beyond the Wall
king_beyond_the_wall.description: Much like the many Kings Beyond the Wall who have existed over the years, you are a prodigy when it comes to convincing disparate groups and factions to work together. When it comes to creating cooperation, you could unite a people of a thousand kingdoms, bridge a divide of hatred which has stood several thousand, then keep the resulting alliance together long enough for the factions to first learn to work together, then, with lots of work, forge that alliance into a cohesive whole - though that would probably take decades, maybe even generations if the hatred was as strong as that between the Night Watch and the Free Folk.

old_blood.name: Old Blood
old_blood.description: Within your veins pumps the blood of one of the Great Houses of Westeros, such as Stark or Lannister. As benefiting of your blood, people give you more attention than they normally would when you demand it and are far more likely to bend to your demands or orders than normal. This also gives you a bit of divine right to rule causing vassals to be far less likely to betray you, after all your family has ruled well for centuries.

the_kings_ear.name: The King’s Ear
the_kings_ear.description: Not literally of course, but figuratively and far more valuable. The King or whoever would be equivalent to them in your starting nation, whether that be a Wildling Magnar or Triarch of Volantis now trusts you and sees you as a close confidant and even friend. They’ll always lend and ear to whatever proposals you have in mind and will consistently ask you for advice on major decisions that must be made in the nation, so while you may not be King you certainly can wield a great deal of influence over one.

title_of_land.name: Title of Land
title_of_land.description: A title of land equal to what someone of your station would expect. Regular warriors may have a small block for them and their family, a lord may have a castle, and the surrounding area, a lord paramount may have a massive castle, and an enormous area around as their personal domain, and a royal may have not just an enormous castle, but also an area near equal to the other kingdoms as their land. In future jumps, you can choose to have this be a warehouse attachment, or for it to seamlessly insert itself into the world without anyone but you noticing.

true_nobility.name: True Nobility
true_nobility.description: You're actually a ruler worth the name. You can lead skillfully and with great prosperity. Under your reign, the realm will experience a golden age as great as that of Jaehaerys himself.

source_a_happy_harry_potter_fanfiction.description: Perks from A 'Happy' Harry Potter fanfiction.

basilisk_parts.name: Basilisk Parts
basilisk_parts.description: A lucky find of a case full of the preserved skin, fangs, venom, eyes, bones, and other bits of a fully harvested Basilisk snake, an old one too at least twice as old as the one that lives under Hogwarts. The collection is quite potent and don’t worry about the eyes; they no longer hold the power of its gaze when looked upon, but I’m sure they’ll make a fantastic ingredient in a potion. When you’ve used up all the pieces the case will refill with more parts.

the_black_cauldron.name: The Black Cauldron
the_black_cauldron.description: Yes, that one but a much more user friendly version. A magical indestructible cauldron in which any potion can be brewed to perfection even if the actual results produce a failed solution. With this you'll have no need for silver, gold, brass, or any other type of metal made pot to create your elixirs in and it can be set to produce an infinite amount of whatever potion is made in it until you require another. The cauldron will also eat any sludge left over so that the inside is clean when you next need to use it. The cauldron will produce an undead army on command with the proper chant or revive one person per year to full life and health. Is enchanted to be featherlight so you can lift it without strain. Comes with a complete index of ingredients, their properties, and reactions when mixed, which updates with each world in their own section, as well as a high quality alchemical master's potions kit with all magical and common alchemical ingredients, all the tools and stirring implements to prepare them, plus twenty unbreakable vials, as well as protective gear. The tools are self maintaining and the ingredients self replenishing.

family_clock.name: Family Clock
family_clock.description: This clock is styled after the Weasley family one with hands to represent you and your kin with placeholders like work, school, home, traveling, and mortal peril instead of numbers, as the hands settle on each to tell you if your family is in trouble or not. Your version comes with a box that can hold whatever particular placard you need like 'in battle', dead, camping, etc. along with more hands to add anyone you care to to the clock face. As you add things the clock face will enlarge, until it's big enough to give your fireplace feelings of inadequacy, once it reaches that point you can't add more to it. The hands and placard can only tell you so much but there is a display at the top that can tell you the location, such as coordinates or in the style of the Owl Post, of a person if you tap the hand belonging to them with your wand.

magic_carpet.name: Magic Carpet
magic_carpet.description: What’s more handy than a flying broomstick? A nice large rug, that’s what! This beautifully patterned bit of floor covering can get you anywhere you need to be in the world in just a few hours, or less depending on distance, or longer if you want to just go on a leisurely flight. And nobody will pay attention when you ride it, not even if it’s illegal. Take that Britain! The carpet can expand to allow up to ten people to fly comfortably, with luggage even, it’s never too cold, hot, or breezy, and there’s plenty of safety spells to keep the flight smooth and prevent people from falling off even when you do a loop de loop. Best of all you can just roll it up to take with you and hardly anyone will find it strange and it neither needs maintenance or cleaning.

pocket_watch.name: Pocket Watch
pocket_watch.description: An ornate pocket watch, perhaps left as a gift for you by a parent as a coming of age thing or something you found one day. It keeps accurate time no matter where you are, has a built in compass that never fails to point you in the right direction, can be used as a stopwatch for experiments, and even has a lunar cycle tracker in it. It will always stay clipped to your clothing or be found in your pocket when you take it with you and looks ordinary on the outside to discourage thieves. It cannot be destroyed, nor will it ever stop working, and if you lose it or it is stolen from you it will find its way back into your hands somehow, someway.

gringotts_vault_network.name: Gringotts Vault Network
gringotts_vault_network.description: Sometimes you pick up a whole bunch of valuables and have nowhere to put them, other times you acquire super dangerous objects and want them locked somewhere where they won't hurt anybody by accident, and then there's moments when you need a bunker when the sky is falling, there's a demon on your front lawn, and Doomguy just kicked your backdoor open. The Gringotts network is all of those things. A maze of rollercoasters with all sorts of security deep in the earth and sprawled out over eighty levels with vaults just waiting to be filled, and you have the skeleton key for all of them. The lowest level vaults are designed and magically protected to keep the worst things in or out if needed, even your first level vaults could tank a nuke going off above them. Each vault can be adjusted to include utilities and environment controls for an extended stay inside if you desire, with the network connecting seamlessly to your warehouse and other properties you own, if you desire, via a basement access with the tunnels and vaults themselves not displacing the earth wherever your warehouse settles but acting like a pocket dimension anchored to your storage building. All the vaults have specialized space expansion charms that will increase their interior size if you fill them beyond capacity, or put a base in a few, the charms are guaranteed not to fail. Keys for any vault of your choice can be made but only your skeleton key can open all of them. What's more, if you've acquired any other vault type structures they will be perfectly incorporated into the network and other underground complexes will have an access point to your secret stash somewhere within them if you don’t import them into a vault.

apocalyptic_foretellings.name: Apocalyptic Foretellings
apocalyptic_foretellings.description: Dropping into a setting is all well and good when you’re just here to see the sights but it is such a bummer when you go anyplace that’s set to end in two years or something and you didn’t know an apocalypse was scheduled. This book foretells the ways the world will end; not how, will, assuming no heroic intervention occurs even if it does in the original story. It also keeps a record of what can threaten a world into ending, not necessarily the end that’s coming so much as if something has been set up to make the world end like a dead-man’s-switch attached to a guy’s heart to release a deadly virus if he dies. The writing will tell you the date the world ends, how it ends as in what type of apocalypse you’re dealing with, and one key component to what sets it off which may be subject to change if you miss your window of opportunity. Artificial apocalypses are kept track of much the same way except you’ll know how many dead-man’s-switches there are in order to neutralize them if you’re able. In future Jumps your book will expand to include not just the things threatening your homeworld directly but also those that can hurt it by proxy such as the universe or multiverse being destroyed, an incoming asteroid, alien wars spilling over into your home system, etc.

astro_specs.name: Astro Specs
astro_specs.description: These glasses can let you see the night sky through things, buildings, underground, bad weather, and during the day. It comes with handy features that allow you to highlight constellations, zoom in on distant objects and bodies, and display information about them such as their history, symbolization, and magical significance.

mirror_mirror.name: Mirror Mirror
mirror_mirror.description: A magic unbreakable mirror that can freely scry anywhere in the universe or its adjacent dimensions, even through a Fidelius Charm. Comes with a talking reflection of yourself that can comment on your appearance and fight off any beings that use mirrors as gateways should you run across any in other jumps. It also keeps those beings from scrying on you through the mirror itself.

source_a_marvel_cinematic_universe.description: Perks from A Marvel Cinematic Universe.

the_lost_valkyrie.name: The Lost Valkyrie
the_lost_valkyrie.description: Tall, muscular, incredibly attractive, blonde and blue eyed Asgardian Valkyrie, Freya was one of the Valkyries best warriors. She barely survived the fight against Hela, and spent the time since hiding on earth. While at a cafe, she met you by accidentally spilling coffee down your shirt. When she asked how she could apologize, you asked for a date. Flattered, she accepted. The first date went well, and she’s now waiting for the second one, her time with you being the first time she has enjoyed herself since she was with her Valkyrie sisters.

hela.name: Hela
hela.description: The Asgardian goddess of death and former Executione of Asgard. But when, her ambition outgrew Odin’s, he banished her, caging and locking her away like an animal, banishing her to the desolate wastes of Hel, condemned to rule an eternity. So imagine her surprise when you and her somehow managed to get a mental connection. Every night, while sleeping, you were projecting to Hela, and though she at first tried to get rid of you, then tried to ignore you when that didn’t work, you slowly managed to integrate yourself into her good graces. Having been lonely for a millennia with no one to talk to besides herself, she at first struggled with being social, but you slowly made her come out of her shell. Eventually, she came to long for the few hours when you where there with her, to have someone to talk with. As you two got to know each other, you took the role of a friend/psychologist, who she could unwind with and tell about all her woes with her father and what happened in the past, until she eventually came to terms with it. She is still a raging, impatient, volatile, and supremely ambitious personality masked by a casual confidence and appearance of friendliness, but she has realized that she is an effective and brutal wartime leader, but not a Queen fit for peace, at least not yet. And though she still doesn’t agree with her father, and is still angry at what he did, she also accepts that she had let her ambition and bloodlust grow too uncontrollable. And while talking and getting to know each other over time, she also realized she had begun to form an... attachment to you. Now that she has realized how deep this attachment is, she will let nothing stop her from having you, from protecting you, from... loving you. Her only hope is that you will love her back, and accept her in all her divine, beautiful and monstrous glory.

source_a_marvel_cinematic_universe_jump.description: Perks from A Marvel Cinematic Universe Jump.

mjolnir.name: Mjolnir
mjolnir.description: Mjolnir, a powerful enchanted war-hammer forged by the Dwarves. It is an incredibly versatile weapon, yet it also has the ability to help you control and focus any power you have. It will return to you whenever you summon it, and it’s enchanted in such a way that the only ones who can lift it are those you consider worthy of lifting it, which you are free to choose and change at any times what makes someone worthy. You may choose to have the hammer grant anyone who is worthy access to your powers, and may choose what powers they have access to, or if they only have access to the hammer itself, in which case it will help them focus and control their own powers, should they have any. It grants you access to your very own Asgardian armor (of your own design), and has the added ability to resurrect you should you die. Yours is also indestructible, unlike the Original Mjolnir.

cloak_of_levitation.name: Cloak of Levitation
cloak_of_levitation.description: Your very own Cloak of Levitation, a magical relic wielded by Doctor Strange that is able to move and fly on its own power, and also enabling its user to fly, levitate and hover in the air. you may change it’s appearance and personality however you want. It will fit you perfectly, and unlike Strange’s, yours is indestructible.

divinity.name: Divinity
divinity.description: You are now a God of equal might as Hela, Zeus and Thor. This will give you several abilities of your choice, from the same Lightning and Weather manipulation as Thor to the Necrosword and Necromancy of Hela, or something completely different. This will also increase all your physical capabilities immensely, as well as all the other abilities of a God from MCU.

chaos_magic.name: Chaos Magic
chaos_magic.description: You are now a natural wielder of Chaos Magic, akin to the myth of the Scarlet Witch, allowing you to warp reality. You can wield Chaos Magic subconsciously without needing constant concentration to sustain the magic, essentially able to do magic on autopilot. Your potential is limitless and you will eventually grow into one of the most powerful beings in the multiverse, even without any training.

scarlet_witch.name: Scarlet Witch
scarlet_witch.description: Wanda Maximoff, the born wielder of Chaos Magic and the Psionically enhanced by an Infinity Stone. She fell into a dark place, trying to escape. But you came in, like a light on a dark room, and dragged her out of it. Ever since, you have been her light, the one thing she cares about above all else. Having developed strong romantic feelings for you, she is devoted, loving and caring, all while hiding her slight obsession and her possessive urges towards you

source_a_song_of_ice_and_fire.source: A Song of Ice and Fire
source_a_song_of_ice_and_fire.description: Perks from A Song of Ice and Fire.

pouch_of_gold.name: Pouch of Gold
pouch_of_gold.description: A pouch of golden coins. Around 100 Golden Dragons worth. May be taken multiple times.

source_a_song_of_ice_and_fire_jumpchain.source: A Song of Ice and Fire Jumpchain
source_a_song_of_ice_and_fire_jumpchain.description: Perks from A Song of Ice and Fire Jumpchain.

starforged_sword.name: Starforged Sword
starforged_sword.description: A sword made out of the remnants of a fallen star. Milky white and intensely shiny. Around as sharp and light as Valyrian Steel. Gives a strong impression of chivalry and honour. You may also import any melee weapon you own to take on the appearance and strengths of the sword.

green_dreams.name: Green Dreams
green_dreams.description: You will occasionally dream entirely in green. These dreams are prophetic and of important events but difficult to decipher. You can effect the prophesised future.

horn_of_joruman.name: Horn of Joruman
horn_of_joruman.description: A large, ornate and legendary hunting horn capable of massive destruction to even the largest of structures. Can only be used on a weekly basis but can bring practically any building (or Wall) tumbling down when blown.

alewifes_revenge.name: Alewife’s Revenge
alewifes_revenge.description: This notorious poison is colourless, odourless, and tasteless, delivering a fatal dose within 30 minutes of consumption. Symptoms begin with facial swelling, dizziness, and delirium, followed by a racing heart, loss of motor function, and vivid hallucinations before death ensues. If desired, you can manifest this poison as a bottle of red wine for a more subtle delivery.

beginner_witch_spellbook.name: Beginner Witch Spellbook
beginner_witch_spellbook.description: A small, black-covered handbook filled with introductory spells and notes on witchcraft, perfect for beginners easing into the craft. No need to worry about the fine print; the text is effortlessly legible to you. This spellbook updates itself with foundational content from any world you visit, and adds spells and guidance from any experienced witches who mentor you along the way.

big_magick.name: Big Magick
big_magick.description: You are the offspring of a mythical witch, you possess extraordinary magical reserves, enabling you to cast spells tirelessly and without strain. Your essence is attuned to all forms of magic, allowing you to wield spells across disciplines as effortlessly as those who have mastered them. With power that runs deep and vast, you can bring even your wildest imaginings to life, bending reality to your will and creating pocket realms from mere fantasy.

claw_your_way_out.name: Claw Your Way Out
claw_your_way_out.description: "Jane Doe" is a term used for someone whose identity is concealed for various reasons. But you are not one of the faceless—you know who you are, and what you are. Should you ever find yourself trapped by forces that threaten to erase or alter your identity—be it through mental manipulation, physical transformation, or other means—you possess the resilience and ability to break free. It may take time, but rest assured, you will claw your way out of any situation that tries to bury your true self.

cleansing_bell.name: Cleansing Bell
cleansing_bell.description: This iron bell, a staple in traditional witchcraft, emits a purifying ring that cleanses spaces, wards off negative energies, and banishes unwelcome spirits. When hung in a location, it provides protection against malevolent curses and bad luck for the area.

covenhood.name: Covenhood
covenhood.description: In a true coven, blessings and burdens are shared as one. You can form a coven with others, including those without innate magic, granting all members a significant boost in their magical capabilities. Together, you can perform spells and rituals with flawless synchronisation. Additionally, any curse that might impair a member is shared across the coven, diluting its impact and reducing the harm it would otherwise cause to an individual.

curse_warding_tattoo.name: Curse Warding Tattoo
curse_warding_tattoo.description: This tattoo provides strong resistance against curses, shielding you from the most harmful effects even if it fails to nullify them. You can choose the design, allowing for a personal touch to your protective mark.

green_torch.name: Green Torch
green_torch.description: Death’s journey can be daunting, so it's common for Death to carry a burning green torch, offering souls a brief light to ease the transition. Now, you hold such a torch yourself. This mystical torch allows you to intercept souls and guide them safely, directing them toward a destination of your choosing in the afterlife, whether that’s peace, reckoning, or a final farewell.

hexenbesen.name: Hexenbesen
hexenbesen.description: Though witches may have mixed feelings about the association, flying brooms have become an iconic symbol of their culture. You now own one of these enchanted brooms, allowing you to travel swiftly and freely through the air. Additionally, you hold the knowledge of the ritual needed to craft more of these magical rides.

i_loved_being_a_witch.name: I Loved Being A Witch
i_loved_being_a_witch.description: You take deep pride in who you are and what you stand for, finding joy and fulfilment simply in being yourself. You’ve reached a place of inner peace and complete self-acceptance. No matter what challenges come or when the end draws near, you’ll never lose sight of yourself and face it without a hint of regret for the life you’ve lived and the choices you’ve made.

kale_kare_cosmetics.name: Kale Kare Cosmetics
kale_kare_cosmetics.description: Every month, you’ll receive a carefully curated crate of exclusive cosmetic and wellness products crafted by the skilled Potions Witch, Jennifer Kale. These items range from potent retinol serums to edible, probiotic-infused scented candles. For those looking to add a bit of spice, there are also unique items like jade eggs, blending fun with holistic health benefits.

latin.name: Latin
latin.description: You possess fluency in reading, writing, speaking and understanding Latin, an ancient Roman language that has deep ties with incantations used to invoke magicks.

lorna_wus_ballad.name: Lorna Wu’s Ballad
lorna_wus_ballad.description: Just as Lorna once wove a protective spell into a song that shielded her child from a generational curse whenever it was played, you too can embed the effects of your abilities, spells, or perks into works of art—whether it’s a song, painting, sculpture, or other creation. The more someone engages with your art, the stronger the effect becomes, channelling your power through each brushstroke, note, or crafted form.

mind_reader.name: Mind Reader
mind_reader.description: You possess the power to read the minds of others, peering into the thoughts and emotions they may hide behind their facades. However, this ability is not infallible; those with appropriate skills can shield their thoughts from your insight.

musical_band_set.name: Musical Band Set
musical_band_set.description: Curses are notoriously insidious, clinging like formless malice that resists removal. With this set of musical instruments—ranging from piano and zils to triangles and more—you can channel curses, giving them a physical form as you play. Once manifested, these curses can be destroyed, burning into ashes as your performance reaches its final note. The effectiveness of curse removal depends on the song, with Lorna’s Ballad being the most potent for complete eradication.

ouija_board.name: Ouija Board
ouija_board.description: This aged birch board and accompanying planchette enable you to summon and communicate with a ghost. You may request a specific spirit (if they’re available and willing) or let a random ghost answer your call. Because this spiritual tool is CP-backed, you won’t face any repercussions for breaking traditional taboos—though showing courtesy and respect is still recommended. The board is functional only for those ages 3 and above.

perfect_pitch.name: Perfect Pitch
perfect_pitch.description: In the world of magic, incantations aren’t always enough—sometimes, the power of a spell is unlocked through song. While off-key singing might be fine for casual fun, it won’t do for serious rituals. Fortunately for you, you possess exceptional vocal talent and perfect pitch. Your voice is finely tuned and can perform with the precision and control of a world-class musical theatre star, allowing you to sing your spells with ease and effectiveness.

potentia_exhaurire.name: Potentia Exhaurire
potentia_exhaurire.description: Like Agatha Harkness, you have the unique ability to absorb magical energy and life force from others when struck by their energy blasts, converting their power into your own. This draining process can feel rapturous, but you retain full control, never becoming addicted to the sensation and able to stop whenever you choose. Exercise care when using this power; avoid unintentionally draining life from your allies or attempting to absorb incompatible powers that could harm or even kill you.

potion_reagent_organiser.name: Potion Reagent Organiser
potion_reagent_organiser.description: This wooden organiser is perfect for storing all your potion ingredients, from eye of newt to prehistoric fossils. With its many compartments, it keeps an endless supply of common potion components ready at hand whenever you need them. However, for rare items like a dragon’s heart or a shard of divinity, you’ll still have to find those yourself.

protection_stones.name: Protection Stones
protection_stones.description: When arranged in a circle, these stones create a barrier that repels any unwanted guests or malevolent forces. Only those with your explicit invitation and approval can cross into the protected space within the circle.

ragebaiter.name: Ragebaiter
ragebaiter.description: You have a unique gift for pushing people’s buttons and provoking their anger. Whether through your words or actions, you excel at getting under others’ skin, often sparking heated reactions or even violence. Your ability to incite fury is unmatched, but beware—provoked individuals may not hesitate to act on their rage. Make sure you're ready to back up your words, as the consequences of angered foes can be swift and unforgiving.

shapeshifter.name: Shapeshifter
shapeshifter.description: As a skilled witch, you have a deep connection to a creature of your choice—be it a bat, rat, crow, or something else from the natural world. You can summon these creatures as your loyal familiar, or even transform yourself into one, taking on their form and abilities at will.

sometimes_boys_die.name: Sometimes, Boys Die
sometimes_boys_die.description: But for you, they don’t have to. You hold the power to reverse such an ending. With this ability, you can resurrect yourself or someone else by taking over the body of a recently deceased, as long as it’s relatively intact. It may defy the natural order, but in your hands, those who have a chance at life can still continue their life. Do note that in worlds with active guardians of life and death, repeated use of this ability will not only upset the balance but may also draw the wrath of these powerful forces, who will view you as a disruptor of their domain.

summonable_cauldron.name: Summonable Cauldron
summonable_cauldron.description: A trusty tool for potion-brewing on the go, this cauldron can be summoned or dismissed at will. By default, it appears as a modern washbasin with a sous vide machine. If you prefer a more classic look, simply switch to its traditional form—a black cauldron complete with a magical flame underneath.

tarot_deck.name: Tarot Deck
tarot_deck.description: This classic deck of 78 tarot cards traces its origins back to the mid-15th century. While it can accurately reveal insights into a person’s past, present, and future, offering guidance tailored to the chosen card spread even in the hands of a newly initiated reader, a skilled readerhowever, would be able to better interpret the cards.

the_green_witch.name: “THE” Green Witch
the_green_witch.description: You are the origin and living embodiment of a specific discipline of witchcraft. With an intimate and comprehensive knowledge of both ancient and modern practices, you are able to invent new techniques and spells with ease. Any spells or techniques created by others withinyour discipline become instantly accessible to you, allowing you to master them effortlessly. What would take others lifetimes of practice, you can achieve with a mere flick of your hand. This boundless well of knowledge and power updates with each new world you visit, ensuring that you remain the unrivalled master of your craft, no matter where you go.

the_witches_road.name: The Witches’ Road
the_witches_road.description: Born from a legendary myth built on lies and brought to life by magic, this pocket reality is now yours to summon. By singing “The Ballad of the Witches’ Road” with a coven of at least five members (none of whom can be clones), you can open a doorway to this mystical realm. The Witches' Road presents each participant with a unique trial that scales to their abilities, forbidding any direct aid from others during the test. If a participant “dies” in the trial, they are safely expelled from the realm. Those who complete the final trial, however, are granted the thing they want the most.

unbinding_ritual.name: Unbinding Ritual
unbinding_ritual.description: Your powers are inherently yours, and no one can dominate or control them. If ever your abilities are bound or sealed by others, you can effortlessly break free with a simple ritual of defiance. By asserting your will and rejecting any external influence, you will regain full access to your powers, leaving any bindings broken in your wake.

witch_repellent.name: Witch Repellent
witch_repellent.description: Crafted from a mix of folk remedies, this homemade liquid repellent surprisingly and effectively wards off witches. When sprayed, it works similarly to bear repellent, causing enough temporary discomfort to drive witches away. Be cautious, though—once the effects wear off, the affected witch will likely be furious, so use this only as a last-ditch defence. This bottle of repellent replenishes itself at the start of each day.

you_need_a_chemical_peel.name: You Need A Chemical Peel
you_need_a_chemical_peel.description: Witches are known for their long lifespans, but longevity doesn’t always come with the gift of graceful ageing. Luckily, you possess an exceptional talent for maintaining your youthful appearance and vitality. No matter how much time passes, your body remains energetic, your skin stays smooth, and you retain the freshness of youth, defying the signs of age with ease.

magic_carpet.name: Magic Carpet
magic_carpet.description: A magic carpet set in the local style. Besides being able to fly at incredible speeds, its loyal, and it is even smart. Although the level of its intelligence is unknown. It is able to understand complex commands, plot, act on its own to save you from danger and more. As for speeds, in a single night it traveled from the Arabian desert to China and back. The magic of the carpet even protects the riders from the ill effects from its flight. Such things include, but not limited to, windburn, whiplash, and the force of sudden changes in speed.

iago.name: Iago
iago.description: You can have this annoying parrot for free. He is loud, cowardly and has an annoying voice. He will start as a smart mouthed pet.

hes_got_a_sword.name: He’s Got A Sword!
hes_got_a_sword.description: In these tough times it would be unwise to not know how to fight. With this you will know which end of a sword is which. You are skilled enough to teach others. Maybe you could get a job doing that.

hygiene.name: Hygiene
hygiene.description: The people of this Disney worlds are always looking their best. Rarely dirty, a great smile, freshly done hair and no BO. Now you have this as well and living in a desert will not affect you as if does others. You no longer need to bathe and your always looks as if you just came from the stylist.

forgotten_citadel.name: Forgotten Citadel
forgotten_citadel.description: There are many lost and ancient ruins in these lands. You just so happened to find one. This hidden Citadel is a bit run down, but nothing some hard work wouldn’t fix. But the real beauty of this place is the fact that it contains a library and apothecary containing everything a sorcerer of this world would need.

freed_genie.name: Freed Genie
freed_genie.description: You seem to have befriended a genie. Maybe it was one that you freed yourself. For whatever reason this free spirited genie has decided to join you on your travels. As a genie they are made of magic, natural shapeshifters, don’t need magical foci or incantations. This one can qualify as a powerful sorcerer from this world, but can still be contained and stopped with the right knowledge. Expect zany antics as genies seem to all have meta knowledge of how the world works.

magic_focus.name: Magic Focus
magic_focus.description: Most magic users have some sort of foci. Just like many feel the need to grow beards. While staffs are the most common foci, rings, amulets, gems and the like are also used. With this you gain a magical foci of your very own. If you are a proper magician then you have some sort of theme going on and this will reflect that. Besides being a foci, your item has a simple, but useful additional ability. Jafar had the whole snake motif going on and his staff was a cobra that could hypnotize people.

sorcerer.name: Sorcerer
sorcerer.description: You have the power and knowledge of real magic. No more parlour tricks for you. Know the incantations to summon monsters, magical lore and the casting of great power. You might not be the most powerful sorcerer in the world, but the magic of this world is varied and powerful. Mozenrath had the power to turn all citizens in his city into mindless zombies. Sadira was a sand witch with power over sand. She once even created a pocket dimension. The siren Saleen had the power to bewitch and turn Aladdin into a shark. Select a theme and gain an impressive alt-form for it. Similar to Jafar’s snake form.

bottle_of_entrapment.name: Bottle of Entrapment
bottle_of_entrapment.description: This old looking bottle or lamp comes with a very Arabic look to it. Though many might overlook it as a piece of junk, you know its real value. With the right incantation smoke will billow out from the opening to trap your target. Not all people or things can be trapped this way, Ghosts, spirits, elementals and genies are the easiest to capture. Gods are just too powerful for this and some other more powerful entities might have their own methods of escape. But once captured you will be able to telepathically commune with whatever has been trapped inside. This item is more about containment than enslavement. Though some spirits may be willing to barter for their freedom. The bottle can only hold a single entity.

cassims_dagger.name: Cassim’s Dagger
cassims_dagger.description: This old dagger was a gift from your long lost father or someone’s long lost father. Though it is simple steel, this dagger will never rust or dull. But on top of that all, the handle holds a vague symbol that will change once per jump to match that of a secret society. It will make the holder as a legacy and ease membership. This dagger will not prevent other members from challenging you to fights.

comfortable_throne.name: Comfortable Throne
comfortable_throne.description: This throne is so damn comfortable, you might not ever want to get up. But in all seriousness. This is the perfect throne for you. While it has no great aura to intimidate the peasants, it will change to match what kind of ruler you are. It will also grow too small and uncomfortable for any that you would disapprove of, if they were to be foolish enough to usurp you

disguise_kit.name: Disguise Kit
disguise_kit.description: Sometimes people just need to hide. And sometimes it is best to hide in plain sight. You gain a simple, but effective disguise. You can decide what it looks like, but default is an old beggar with a humpback and long beard.

eating_from_the_gutter.name: Eating From The Gutter
eating_from_the_gutter.description: Being a street rat isn’t easy. Food is often times hard to come by and sometimes it is best not to look before you bite. With this perk you gain a steel stomach that can digest anything edible without ill effects. So, don’t worry if there is a little mold on the bread or the meat has turned green.

honor_among_thieves.name: Honor Among Thieves
honor_among_thieves.description: A problem with working with underhanded cutthroats is that they are underhanded cutthroats. Most will kill you for that fortune and think nothing less of it. Where is the Disney romance in that? You now form strong bonds with your brothers of the shadows. And that is what you will become, a brotherhood of thieves. Each working together for the betterment of the group and not just themselves. Even crooks outside of your organization tend to keep their word when dealing with you. You could lead a vast criminal empire with this.

one_jump_ahead_of_the_lawman.name: One Jump Ahead Of The Lawman
one_jump_ahead_of_the_lawman.description: What good is being a thief if you always get caught? Where some could be called nimble or agile, you are a cut above the rest. And when I say that, I mean near double what an average man would be capable of. Faster feet, more flexibility, and better sleight of hand make you the thief others look up to.

books.name: Books
books.description: It may not seem like much, but books can teach people a lot. You gain a complete collection of mathematical, historical, and other classic literature from this world.

learned.name: Learned
learned.description: Few people take the time to learn, such a shame really. Few people in a world like this even know how to read. You are a man that has dedicated his time and efforts into learning as much as you can. Philosophy, mathematics, architecture, poetry, and more. You can read the stars and know the best time for planting crops. You have the knowledge of a classical scholar. Don’t be surprised if people come asking for your advice.

treasure_map.name: Treasure Map
treasure_map.description: There are so many places for someone like you to find. This map starts blank, but if you write the name of a treasure or location you desire onto the top of the paper then the lines of this map will begin to fill in. You can name anything, such as: the location of Atlantis, Hand of Midas, or even true love. It might not be the safest of journeys. Once you have your treasure in hand, the map will change so that you are lead to the nearest town or city before vanishing in a puff of smoke. The map will update once per jump and lead you to a new location.

city_state.name: City State
city_state.description: Your own personal city to rule over. You can build it anyway you want or take a preexisting city to claim. Be it the cheese loving city of Odiferous, the Land of Black Sand or some place else. Whatever it is, it is now yours to rule over as you see fit. It is a well known and prosperous trade hub in its region. You may import a previous city as this one. If taken with Vanishing Isle you may combine the two. Yes, it can be Agrabah if you are part of the royal family in one way or another.

grand_vizier.name: Grand Vizier
grand_vizier.description: One great thing about knowing the higher mysteries is that many people will look for your help. Not only that, they are more trusting of you despite your shadier aspects. . Allowing you to gain the upper hand. People are more willing to seek you advice and treat you as a valued confidant than they would normally be. You also now have all the practical knowledge on how to keep a kingdom running smoothly, even if the ruling sultan is a fool.

looks_fit_for_royalty.name: Looks Fit for Royalty
looks_fit_for_royalty.description: This is Disney and with Disney there is one rule: all the heroes and princesses must be attractive. Now you fit that mold and will be at least an 8/10. Thank you Disney eugenics. This trait will be passed on to your offspring.

loved_by_her_people.name: Loved By Her People
loved_by_her_people.description: Some rulers are feared by the people the rule over, some are hated, and even more just view their lords in a neutral light. But now you are loved by your people. They know that you are there looking out for their best interests. You might not always be the right thing, but your people understand that sometimes a good leader must have a strong hand. It will take a lot to get your citizens to rise up against you. You will also find an easier time recruiting people to settle in your territories.

old_lamp.name: Old Lamp
old_lamp.description: This is an old looking and outdated lamp, but it holds secrets. Inside is a moderately sized mansion styled to your specifications. To get in all one has to do is rub the lamp and smoke will appear to whisk you inside. Great place to hold secret meetings, throw a party, smuggle people across international borders or just keep a harem. You can even use it to sneak people across a boarder.

ace_of_winchester.name: Ace of Winchester
ace_of_winchester.description: This magical rifle was created by an unknown mystic during the time of the Old West. This .44 lever action repeater has been enchanted to never miss when fired and has the power to outright annihilate most demons.

bottled_lazarus_pit_water.name: Bottled Lazarus Pit Water
bottled_lazarus_pit_water.description: This plastic bottle is full of water from the Lazarus Pit, a magical water that brings back the dead and slows the aging. The bottle is enough to change a swimming pool worth of water into a Lazarus Pit. The bottle refills every jump and has no side effect of the crazies. Note that the Lazarus Pit can only bring back the body & memories, a special ritual is needed to bring the soul back. Fortunately for you, the Dummies Guide to Lazarus Pit comes included. The water is free of any pesky extra souls.

magical_peddler.name: Magical Peddler
magical_peddler.description: Magic is real but hidden. Take for instance a certain taxicab, it's magical, allowing you to travel great distances across the country, very quickly. To an ordinary bloke, it's just a yellow cab. You however know what magic looks like, and know where to obtain real magical items fairly easily. The more magic that resides in an object the harder it is to obtain.

magical_card.name: Magical Card
magical_card.description: A charmed card that is able to take on the appearance of whatever its holder requires. Examples include using this card to imitate a credit card and a health and human services I.D.

occult_knowledge.name: Occult Knowledge
occult_knowledge.description: As if you've been studying the occult for at least a decade, your knowledge of the occult is second only to one other. You're able to identify a large number of demons, angels, magical artifacts of old, as well the language skills to decipher ancient texts in long dead or carefully hidden languages. When your time here is finished you'll similarly be filled with the occult knowledge of any at roughly the same level of your new location.

valyrian_steel_link.name: Valyrian Steel Link
valyrian_steel_link.description: The Maesters of the Citadel frown on magic, not because it takes power out of their hands, whatever you may have heard, but because it so invariably requires human sacrifice to carry out. For you this link is something you can attach to a magical focus or any item that boosts your maical power for an extra boost.

source_asoiaf_-_the_small_council.description: Perks from ASOIAF - The Small Council.

fear_cuts_deeper_than_swords.name: Fear Cuts Deeper Than Swords
fear_cuts_deeper_than_swords.description: Your unmatched willpower allows you to stay focused and disciplined no matter the circumstances. You do not stop fighting. Even drenched in your own blood, you press on until there is no life left behind your eyes. You will survive, you will push on, you will not yield, no matter the tribulations. You can stand and draw your sword against a tide of death without hesitation, and you will cling to survival with every ounce of your strength a dozen times over.

storied_hero.name: Storied Hero
storied_hero.description: You are the epitome of knighthood, an unparalleled force on the battlefield and the paragon of the Kingsguard. You could match the swordsmanship of Ser Arthur Dayne, the leadership of Ser Duncan the Tall, the bravery of Ser Barristan the Bold, the beauty of Ser Jaime Lannister, and the nobility of Prince Aemon the Dragonknight. You easily stand as the greatest knight to ever live in every facet of the ideal. Your presence alone can sway the tide of battles, lifting allies’ spirits and striking despair into foes. Your skill with a blade is such that people would call you the Warrior reborn, allowing you to win a bout when outnumbered and surrounded on all sides. Your poise, gallantry, and skill set you apart, making you a living legend, an example for all the world to follow.

lies_and_arbor_gold.name: Lies and Arbor Gold
lies_and_arbor_gold.description: A single bottle of the finest Arbor Gold, a vintage so rare and smooth that it’s guaranteed to impress even the most skeptical of drinkers. But its true power lies in its ability to grease the wheels of deception. Serve this wine to someone, and they will believe almost any lie you tell them during the course of their intoxication. However, the effects are not foolproof—evidence to the contrary will break the illusion, and once sobriety returns, the lie will be judged as any other. Use it to spin tales, seal deals, or save your life in a pinch.

light_up_a_room.name: Light Up a Room
light_up_a_room.description: You are a natural charmer, with an effortless talent for wit, storytelling, and conversation. You can disarm even the coldest of strangers, turning guarded individuals into fast friends. From soothing tensions to drawing laughter from a crowd, you command attention with your boundless charisma. Even those at the receiving end of a well-placed jest can’t help but feel an undeniable fondness for you.

no_happy_accidents.name: No Happy Accidents
no_happy_accidents.description: You hold full control over your own fertility, deciding precisely if and when you wish to conceive, without fear of accidental pregnancy. Additionally, you are entirely immune to diseases transmitted through intimacy, granting you peace of mind and security in even the closest liaisons. If you experience them, you may choose to never have a period again should you wish it to be so

poise_and_stature.name: Poise and Stature
poise_and_stature.description: Your bearing adjusts to fit precisely the impression you wish to create. You can carry yourself with an aura that commands fear, inspires loyalty, evokes respect, or even invites underestimation, depending on what serves your purpose best.

that_smell.name: That Smell
that_smell.description: You are always impeccably clean and can choose exactly how you’d like to smell, no matter what you’ve been through. From your perspective, everything and everyone around you also smells perfectly pleasant—even if you’re wading through filth or haven’t seen a bath in weeks.

whisper_the_right_words.name: Whisper the Right Words
whisper_the_right_words.description: You have an almost supernatural knack for saying just the right thing at the right time to be selected for prestigious or influential tasks. Be it a quiet word in a lord’s ear, a rousing speech, or an earnest request, your words naturally present you as the ideal candidate for opportunities that lead to power, wealth, or influence. You are frequently offered chances others might dream of, as your instincts for advancement are sharp and reliable.

blood_of_the_dragon.name: Blood of the Dragon
blood_of_the_dragon.description: The ancient magic of Valyria flows in your veins, granting you unparalleled command over dragons and their secrets. You possess the rare ability to tame and breed dragons, bending even the most willful of them to your will. With focus and care, you can awaken seemingly dormant or petrified dragon eggs without the need for sacrifice, breathing fire back into these ancient symbols of power. Dragons respond to you with near-instinctive obedience, and your bond with them grows stronger with time.

the_builder.name: The Builder
the_builder.description: You have inherited the ingenuity and creativity that Bran the Builder was said to possess, granting you the ability to design and construct monumental projects that rival the greatest wonders of Westeros. Fortresses that defy siegecraft, walls that stand against the ages, and sprawling structures that awe all who see them are within your grasp. You can complete immense projects in a fraction of the time and with far fewer resources than should be possible, your efficiency supernatural. The things you create are not only practical and enduring but works of art in their own right, imbued with a sense of purpose and majesty that captures the imagination. Whether constructing a castle, designing defenses, or raising a tower to scrape the heavens, your work is guaranteed to stand for generations as a marvel of the world.

the_winds_of_winter.name: The Winds of Winter
the_winds_of_winter.description: Your body possesses an incredible resilience, enabling you to thrive even in the harshest conditions. Native diseases hold little threat, and you endure brutal winters or food shortages with ease, maintaining strength and clarity where others falter. Sickness rarely takes hold, and starvation becomes a distant worry, as you instinctively ration energy and resources within yourself.

mender_of_bones.name: Mender of Bones
mender_of_bones.description: Your medical expertise is nothing short of miraculous. You possess knowledge of anatomy, treatments, and healing techniques well beyond a maester’s usual training, including remedies for rare diseases and subtle methods for disguising poisons as illnesses. With the right herbs and techniques, you can heal with the power of the Mother behind you, or inflict harm with the subtlety of a whisper. In your hands, medicine becomes both a balm of life and an art of the Stranger.

poisons_and_toxins.name: Poisons and Toxins
poisons_and_toxins.description: You’ve mastered the dark art of poison-making. From the subtle and deadly Tears of Lys to the instantly lethal Strangler, no toxin is beyond your skill. You can even craft new and insidious poisons with effects tailored to your needs—toxins that delay their activation for weeks or only target members of a specific family.

eyes_of_gold_en_dragons.name: Eyes of Gold(en Dragons)
eyes_of_gold_en_dragons.description: Your eyes were practically made for making money. With barely a glance, you can discern the true value and quality of practically anything. You can instantly see the differences between the blade of an apprentice blacksmith and the masterwork of a journeyman, and what makes it of more value and higher quality. You even intuitively grasp the value of abstract assets like secrets or knowledge. Finally and arguably most importantly, you know exactly who will pay the most for these things.

gilded_sovereign.name: Gilded Sovereign
gilded_sovereign.description: You have an unparalleled instinct for creating and growing wealth. From humble beginnings, you can build thriving cities, initiate booming trade networks, and enrich entire regions. Within a few years, a small port could become a thriving economic center. In time, your work could rival the prosperity of Braavos or Qarth. You seem to turn financial investments into empires, making you an economic visionary capable of completely reshaping the Westerosi financial landscape.

little_finger_disappearances.name: Little(Finger) Disappearances
little_finger_disappearances.description: The art of “creative bookkeeping” is a skill you’ve mastered. Funds that flow through your hands seem to have the odd habit of vanishing into thin air without raising suspicions. You’re adept at skimming off a cut of every transaction, diversion, or expenditure. You could be funneling it into more personal account or secret projects, but you always find a way to make a little more disappear without a trace. The trail is so well-hidden that even sharp-eyed auditors find it almost impossible to uncover. Even if people are convinced you are doing something suspicious, figuring out what is actually happening will be a task of ages.

puppeteers_purse.name: Puppeteer’s Purse
puppeteers_purse.description: Money talks, and with it you orchestrate rivalries, disrupt alliances, and play your enemies against each other. Through carefully timed loans, gifts, or bribes, you can subtly fuel grudges, incite tensions, and drive wedges between rivals. Even allies of your enemies will hesitate to turn against you directly, focusing instead on whoever you’ve positioned as a greater threat. With this perk, you can ensure that those who seek to undermine you are too busy with each other to target you effectively.

pantry_of_poisons.name: Pantry of Poisons
pantry_of_poisons.description: This collection of deadly substances is an assassin’s dream. It includes rare and infamous poisons like the Tears of Lys, the Strangler, basilisk venom, and a few unnamed concoctions of equal potency. Each poison comes in a discrete, refillable vial, ensuring you never run out. Whether you need to silence a rival discreetly or send a brutal warning, these poisons guarantee results.

grrms_books.name: GRRM’s Books
grrms_books.description: A copy of every book written by George R.R. Martin about the universe of A Song of Ice and Fire, including A World of Ice and Fire and Fire and Blood. You can summon and dismiss these as you desire and they may take on whatever appearance you desire.

illuminator.name: Illuminator
illuminator.description: A natural teacher and storyteller, you have an extraordinary talent for explaining complex ideas in ways that captivate and educate. Texts you write are remembered as masterworks, shaping society’s philosophies and traditions long after you’re gone. Your influence can establish entire schools of thought, religious doctrines, or cultural norms, leaving a legacy that persists across generations. The best teachers, of course, are also the best learners; you have an uncanny ability to absorb new knowledge quickly, able to master skills and concepts at remarkable speed.

informed_intellectual.name: Informed Intellectual
informed_intellectual.description: Your knowledge extends to the very limits of maesterly duties, encompassing history, philosophy, medicine, science, and ravenry, with insights that stretch as far as Yi-Ti. Any knowledge a maester would have to know, you possess in spades, making you a scholarly titan of the world. Furthermore, your credibility grows to match your expertise; no one, not even the skeptical or mistrustful, will question your words. You are an authority beyond reproach.

divination.name: Divination
divination.description: The First Men would name you a greenseer; the Targaryens would call you a dreamer. You possess the rare and enigmatic gift of prophecy. This ability grants you premonitions, glimpses of the future that come in visions, dreams, or sudden flashes of insight. These visions can be cryptic and open to interpretation, with truths often hidden beneath layers of symbolism. While the Sight can be a powerful tool, beware: prophecy is a double-edged sword. Misinterpretation of what you see can lead to unintended consequences, and knowing the future does not always mean you can change it.

iron_coin.name: Iron Coin
iron_coin.description: A simple yet ominous iron coin bearing the mark of the Faceless Men. When you present this coin and whisper the name of your intended target, a Faceless Man will ensure their death within a week—no matter where they hide or how well-guarded they are. This can only be used once

source_asoiaf_got_hedge_knights_jumpchai.description: Perks from ASOIAF/GOT Hedge Knights Jumpchain.

puppeteer.name: Puppeteer
puppeteer.description: You can create extremely intricate puppets and use them in a show. Watchers will be drawn in by the stories and if you let your hands wander with specific figures you can tell the future. This comes with two puppets - one for each hand - which when held out of sight change to fit the story.

green_hand.name: Green Hand
green_hand.description: You have an incredible knowledge of flora life with an agricultural understanding that would be helpful in farming and foraging. If Winter comes you could grow crops during the harsh seasons. For you, it is easy to find edible plants, just as easy to find poisonous ones and you won’t mistake them for each other.

a_trial_by_combat.name: A Trial by Combat
a_trial_by_combat.description: When honour is forgotten, and chivalry is dead you can call for a one-on-one duel to decide a problem. Instead of going through different legal systems controlled by men, you can call for a trial by combat that puts your life on the line. If you don’t want to fight you can call for willing champions to represent both sides. Legal institutions will accept this as the ruling of a case along with the public opinion.

master_at_arms.name: Master at Arms
master_at_arms.description: You are really good at training warriors. People don’t forget lessons you give them and their taught skills stay ever sharp. This only works on universal things like swords and riding; you can’t teach inherent abilities that come from bloodlines.

iron_allowance.name: Iron Allowance
iron_allowance.description: If you do any job you will be paid a basic wage by this drawstring pouch without any middle organisations. You can also access your money through this and it can’t be stolen.

paying_debts.name: Paying Debts
paying_debts.description: The Lannisters are the richest house in Westeros and even if you don’t have their fortune you have the ability to always get paid. You understand economics and can even get different payment types that are of equal equivalence. Winning a battle for a lord could allow you to be promoted as an example.

iron_price.name: Iron Price
